resource.name: tscaps
resource.creator: francozanardi
resource.category: Subtitles, transcription, dialogue cleanup, and automatic editing
resource.description: Browser video and subtitle editor with local Whisper transcription, animated captions, b-roll, graphics, transitions, audio and optional MCP/agent editing. Exports subtitles and rendered media for Resolve; it does not create editable Fusion captions. Web app 0.7.0 and engine 0.8 are separate versions.
resource.platformNotes: Requires a supported WebCodecs browser. Editor is AGPL-3.0; engine/templates MIT. First use downloads transcription models.

history.name: francozanardi/tscaps
history.summary: Expands the web app from captions into short-video editing with b-roll, graphics, transitions, aspect ratios and audio controls, plus optional MCP/agent editing. Web 0.7.0 and engine 0.8 are separate component versions.
